data.name: Gilani
data.gender_notes: Gilani is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who comes from or is related to a garden. The name Gilani carries the meaning “From the Garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Gilani usually hope their child will grow to embody from the garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of growth, beauty, and tranquility
data.etymology: Gilani belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “From the Garden.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gilani total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: جيلاني
in_arabic.meaning: منسوب إلى الإمام عبد القادر الجيلاني
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الإمام عبد القادر الجيلاني، مؤسس الطريقة القادرية، و هو من أعلام الإسلام في القرن الثاني عشر الميلادي، يرمز إلى الروحانية و التأثير الروحي العميق

in_urdu.name: گیلانی
in_urdu.meaning: عبد القادر گیلانی سے منسوب، صوفی بزرگ
in_urdu.long_meaning: گیلانی نام عبد القادر گیلانی کی نسبت سے ہے، جو صوفی بزرگ اور قادریہ طریقت کے بانی تھے، ان کا نام روحانیات اور تصوف کی تعلیمات کے ساتھ منسلک ہے

in_hindi.name: गिलानी
in_hindi.meaning: अब्दुल कादिर गिलानी से संबंधित, सूफी संत
in_hindi.long_meaning: गिलानी नाम सूफी संत अब्दुल कादिर गिलानी से लिया गया है, जो इस्लामी दुनिया में एक प्रमुख आध्यात्मिक व्यक्ति थे, उनकी विरासत और शिक्षाएं आज भी प्रासंगिक हैं

in_pashto.name: جيلاني
in_pashto.meaning: عبد القادر جيلاني ته منسوب، صوفي لوی

in_english.name: Gilani
in_english.meaning: Related to Abd al-Qadir Gilani, a Sufi saint
in_english.long_meaning: Gilani is derived from the name of Abd al-Qadir Gilani, a renowned Sufi saint and founder of the Qadiri order. data.cultural_impact: The name "Gilani" carries a rich cultural heritage in the Islamic world, with its roots associated with gardens and greenery. In many Islamic and Middle Eastern cultures, gardens are symbolic of paradise and a place of relaxation, gathering, and renewal. The name Gilani may reflect a connection to this deep cultural appreciation for the beauty and serenity that nature offers.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Gilani can be seen as a reminder of the divine beauty and sustenance found in nature. In Islamic mysticism, or Sufism, there is a strong emphasis on the unity of God in all things, including nature. The name Gilani may serve as a daily reminder for the bearer to seek connection with the divine, to find peace and calm in natural surroundings, and to appreciate the beauty and sustenance of God's creation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "From the Garden" symbolizes One who comes from or is related to a garden. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Gilani serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of from the garden.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that The Gilani Sufi Order was founded by Abdul Qadir Gilani in the 11th century. The name Gilani carried significant weight in that era.
